title: The canonical finite-cycle projection is epic with its intrinsic alpha-image kernel
statement: Let C be an abelian category and X a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple]. Fix r natural and p,q integer. Suppose D_r(p+2,q-1) is zero and initialG at (p,q) factors through Z_r of [def-sp-convergence]. Its lift followed by the canonical tower projection onto E_r is epimorphic. Its kernel is the pullback along alphaIter r from D(p,q) to D(p-r,q+r) of the image of incomingAlphaIter (r+1) at (p-r,q+r). No half-plane or colimit hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: proof paragraph 2: finite-page successive-image quotient, before passage to the infinite page

proof.text: Use pageCouple_image of [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact]. Identify its recursively prescribed incoming powers A with incomingAlphaIter by induction. The outgoing alphaIter r has the same image as incomingAlphaIter r at its endpoint, because their source and target transports are isomorphisms. Consequently its image equals the image of the monic I_r. Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk identifies these image domains. Compose the actual image epimorphism of alphaIter with this isomorphism to construct e, prove it epic, and prove e followed by I_r equals alphaIter. No arbitrary witness of existence is used as data.
Apply [lem-sp-finite-cycle-derived-comparison] to this e to identify e followed by transported derived g with the prescribed initialG lift followed by the finite cycle projection.

At the endpoint (p-r,q+r), exact_g identifies the kernel of derived g with the incoming restricted-alpha image. Its monic pushforward along I_r is the image of I_(r+1), by the successor recurrence and cancellation of the epic alpha-image factorization. The pageCouple_image equality identifies this with incomingAlphaIter(r+1). Mathlib pullback_equalizer, specialized to g and zero, proves ker(e followed by g) is the pullback of ker(g) along e. Pullback composition and pullback_map_self for monic I_r now give the asserted pullback along alphaIter r.

The zero following D term makes the following f zero. Exact_f therefore says image(g) is top. The image inclusion kills the cokernel projection, so cancellation of the top arrow makes that projection zero; Abelian.epi_of_cokernel_pi_eq_zero proves g epic. Its composite with the constructed epic e and the endpoint isomorphism is epic. Combine this with the kernel identity.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCycle_kernel_presentation (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0)
    (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ)
    (hnext : IsZero ((X.pageCouple r).D (p + 2) (q - 1)))
    (hg : (X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q).Factors (X.initialG p q)) :
    Epi ((X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q).factorThru (X.initialG p q) hg ≫
      X.cycleBoundaryTower.projection r p q) ∧
    kernelSubobject ((X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q).factorThru
        (X.initialG p q) hg ≫ X.cycleBoundaryTower.projection r p q) =
      (Subobject.pullback (X.alphaIter r p q)).obj
        (imageSubobject (X.incomingAlphaIter (r + 1) (p - r) (q + r)))
